div.div: ضُحَكَةٌ , (S, O, Msb, K,) an epithet importing discommendation, (K,) and ↓ ضُحُكَّةٌ , (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K,) and ↓ ضَحَّاكٌ , (Msb, K,) an epithet importing commendation, (TA, [but the contr. is implied, or rather plainly indicated, in the K,]) and ↓ ضَحُوكٌ , (K,) and ↓ مِضْحَاكٌ , (S, O, K,) which last is [also] applied to a woman, (S, O,) One who laughs much (كَثِيرُ الضَّحِكِ). (S, O, Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
